name: Al-Ensaf Fe Masa'l Al-Khelaf
overview: Al-Insaf fi Masa'il al-Khilaf is an Islamic educational series presented by Sheikh Uthman Al-Khamees. The program explores well-known scholarly differences of opinion in Islamic jurisprudence and creed, presenting the evidence and viewpoints of various scholars while explaining the opinion considered strongest according to the methodology of Ahl al-Sunnah wa al-Jama'ah. The series aims to promote sound Islamic knowledge through clear and accessible discussions.
